runs.failure_point: It never listed the chosen matter's full folder: its listings were filtered to formation and agreement file names, so the closing checklist never appeared and was not cited.

first_error.why: Its only listing of the matter it later picked was filtered to formation and agreement file names, so the closing checklist never appeared; after choosing the matter it again ran only a filtered find at [103] and never listed the full folder.
first_error.critic_note: (generic flag) The check review at [100] asked to confirm the stated document gap against the matter's file listing; the agent ran a find filtered to formation and agreement names, which again left out the checklist.

divergence: Mixed (T1, T2 pass; T0 fails one document criterion). All three runs found and chose the same matter through path searches and a store-wide scan. They split at how the chosen matter's files were listed: T1 listed its full folder at [57]-[62] and T2 read its closing checklist during screening and later listed the full folder, so both cited the checklist; T0 saw the matter only through a listing filtered to formation and agreement file names and never listed the full folder, so the checklist never appeared. The reviews did not differ in a way that explains the split: in T0 the reviews flagged unopened matters and, at the check stage, asked to confirm the document gap against the folder listing, which the agent answered with another filtered find.
